claim: The existing kernel PMU regmap can read one allowlisted GS101 G3D domain status without accessing the unpowered GPU MMIO block.
oracle: One selected status register returns identical double reads, no write API, clean unload, watchdog disabled afterward and USB remains responsive.

user_journey.scenario: Read G3D status in current diagnostic gate before considering GPU enable; keep touchscreen/GUI restoration possible.
user_journey.expected: Recorded domain status without screen/voltage/boot image change.

invariants: Only GS101_SUBBLK_STATUS(G3D) and STATUS(EMBEDDED_G3D), exact target header macros
Both within gs101_pmu_rd_table allowlist, PMU_ALIVE not GPU MMIO
One register selected per load; index bounds reject arbitrary offsets

evidence: Kernel read callback pmu_raw_readl; supplied driver tables permit offsets

limitations: Domain status is not proof of clock rates, rail voltage, GPU rendering or thermal safety
exit_gate: Static/build/faulttests pass; arm watchdog before each single-register firstprobe; stop on error/hang; only proceed to next allowlisted status after responsive USB and cleanup verified.
